# SpikeFusionLayer

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A dedicated neural network layer that combines spike trains from multiple input modalities (e.g., infrared and visible) using spike-timing-dependent operations to produce a fused representation. Provides a biologically plausible and hardware-friendly mechanism for multi-sensor fusion in neuromorphic systems, critical for real-time edge processing.
